fusions.name: Palmed Edge
fusions.desc: A quick cut that deals 5 damage, leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds and makes it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Sheathed Verdict
fusions.desc: Consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to this blow for 20 damage. It only strikes a target at or below 30% of its health.

fusions.name: Hush
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, and you move 15% faster. The veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Dry Spell Edge
fusions.desc: After a run of strikes without a critical hit, you gain 30% critical chance for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
